items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know he didn't work with Punch... Did Punch have his own band in those days? Well, I don't think he was in the regular line up.

ctx.x: But I think Billy, I think Billy and Mary McMulls was both in Mobile, if I ain't mistaken. I believe he is, from Mobile, I believe.
Well, I'll ask Punch. He worked with them for a long time.
Yeah, I worked with them. I worked with them at the Belmont Theater in Pensacola Florida.
